In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

we have demonstrated that ultra-deep recurrent neural networks with stochastic residual learning can achieve state of the art performance for sentiment classification on the fine-grained Stanford sentiment treebank.
we have explored the depths of recurrent neural networks with stochastic residual learning and found that they are indeed deep and that they do have residual learning.
we have demonstrated that recurrent neural networks with ultra-deep layers can achieve state-of-the-art performance on sentiment classification tasks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of residual connections and stochastic timesteps in RNNs is a promising direction to explore.

we have explored the depths of recurrent neural networks with stochastic residual learning, achieving state-of-the-art performance on a popular sentiment classification benchmark, and that we have also proposed a novel technique called stochastic timesteps that may prove useful for future work.
we are able to get a similar accuracy with much less parameters than the current state of the art.
The main takeaway from our work is that
stochastic depth is a very effective technique for improving the robustness and generalization of RNNs, even without the additional benefits of residual connections.
ultra-deep RNNs can be effectively trained with stochastic depth and stochastic timesteps.
stochastic depth and stochastic timesteps can be used to improve the performance of recurrent networks, which are often limited by vanishing and exploding gradients.
